segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yeah, thanks for making the time, Dana. I wanted to walk through the renewal quote and the added seats for the support team, and then we can talk timing for the August go-live.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Sounds good. We’re at 42 seats today, and we need to add 8 more for the new regional managers. So 50 total starting August 15.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Right, 50 seats total. On the annual term, that puts the subscription at $38,400 for the year, and implementation support stays at the one-time $4,800 we discussed.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Okay. And the renewal date would still be September 1, or does adding the seats move that?

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: It stays September 1. We’d prorate the 8 added seats from August 15 through August 31, so that line is $410. Then everything rolls into the new annual term on September 1.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Got it. Can you make the invoice split between software and services? Our finance team needs those as separate lines.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yep, no problem. The invoice will show subscription, prorated seats, and implementation support separately. Payment terms are net 30, same as your current agreement.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: That works. For the services piece, are we still looking at two admin sessions and one end-user training?

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yes. Two 60-minute admin sessions the week of August 5, and one 90-minute end-user training on August 13. We can record that one if helpful.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Please do. I’ll send you the attendee list by next Friday. If you send the updated order form today, I can get it routed for signature.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Perfect. I’ll send the order form with 50 seats, the September 1 renewal date, and the itemized invoice language. You should have it in the next hour.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Great, thanks. Once it’s signed, we’ll introduce you to our IT lead for the setup call.
